fields.summary: TC-669-04: RRO Applied Only to Correct DP When Multiple DPs Exist and Only One Exceeds Threshold

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-669

Precondition: A trip exists with two Duty Periods. DP1 has an actual release delay exceeding the RRO threshold. DP2 actual release delay is within the threshold. RRO should apply only to DP1. Out of Scope: LCO, LRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a multi-DP trip where DP1 release delay exceeds the RRO threshold and DP2 release delay is within threshold
DP1: plannedRelease=2026-03-03T14:00:00Z, actualRelease=2026-03-03T16:25:00Z (145 min). DP2: plannedRelease=2026-03-03T22:00:00Z, actualRelease=2026-03-03T22:30:00Z (30 min)
Trip payload is ready with both DPs and their planned/actual release datetimes
Trigger the RRO Lambda with the multi-DP trip payload
2-DP trip where only DP1 exceeds the RRO threshold
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the RRO lambda evaluates each DP independently for RRO eligibility
DP1 delay = 145 min (exceeds threshold). DP2 delay = 30 min (within threshold)
Lambda processes DP1 and DP2 independently - DP1 qualifies, DP2 does not
Verify rroEligible flag for each DP in the lambda output
DP1 delay=145 min (>threshold), DP2 delay=30 min (<threshold)
DP1: rroEligible = true. DP2: rroEligible = false
Confirm DynamoDB records are updated correctly for each DP separately
Lambda output payload with rroEligible=true for DP1 and rroEligible=false for DP2
DynamoDB: DP1 record shows rroEligible=true, DP2 record shows rroEligible=false
